issue: iPad cannot access Portal :5000 or Grafana :3001 via mDNS hostname

root_cause.mdns: avahi-daemon advertising on link-local (169.254.119.236) instead of WiFi (192.168.1.167)
root_cause.bucket_errors: Grafana alert rules reference non-existent bucket 'weather_lis'

immediate_workaround.ipad_access: Use direct IP instead of hostname

fixes_needed: Reconfigure avahi-daemon to bind to wlan0 (not link-local)
